GENIE.gloss: an invisible spirit mentioned in the Koran and believed by Muslims to inhabit the…
GENIE.definition: (Islam) an invisible spirit mentioned in the Koran and believed by Muslims to inhabit the earth and influence mankind by appearing in the form of humans or animals.

GENE.gloss: a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain
GENE.definition: (genetics) a segment of DNA that is involved in producing a polypeptide chain; it can include regions preceding and following the coding DNA as well as introns between the exons; it is considered a unit of heredity.

PING.example: The bugs pinged the lamp shade.

PEN.definition: A writing implement with a point from which ink flows.

GEN.example: Give me the gen on your new line of computers.

PIN.gloss: to hold fast or prevent from moving
PIN.definition: To hold fast or prevent from moving.
PIN.example: The child was pinned under the fallen tree.

PIE.gloss: dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top
PIE.definition: Dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top.

PEE.example: There was blood in his urine.

GIN.gloss: strong liquor flavored with juniper berries
GIN.definition: Strong liquor flavored with juniper berries.

GEE.gloss: a unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity
GEE.definition: A unit of force equal to the force exerted by gravity; used to indicate the force to which a body is subjected when it is accelerated.
